2Kings 13v4 ESV
Then Jehoahaz sought the favour of the Lord, and the Lord listened to him, for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them

?
Favour isn’t just about being blessed or singled out for honours…its all encompassing.

Favour can deliver in times of distress too.

?because you are favoured of the Lord, whenever you call, He listens.

Though it looks like you may never get out of that situation, when favour is activated, you will eventually come out smelling like a rose.

?In all unpalatable situations, the favour of God upon you will deliver you and give you Amazing testimonies in Jesus name
